Washington handed it to Ekeler, Rodriguez and a limited Croskey-Merritt, Deebo took the few designed touches, and Ertz finished in the 26-yard neighborhood again. Atlanta's 10.8 middle YPA was 15 attempts of noise, and with Terrell out they still had enough shell to sit on the only two healthy veterans. The 38.5 number was already the market's haircut for Daniels being out, and there was no saved price to prove otherwise. That counter-case is why this is a lean flag, not a strong bet, and why Deebo was dropped.
